checks.text: The owner is asked whose mistake a return was
The shop gets a warning that the return was its own mistake
The staff member who made the sale gets a warning

shots.caption: The owner picks whose mistake it was
The staff member who made the sale is warned

notes: What the shop sees: Skip to content Aqua Bazar A A A বাংলা EN 70 Account Market Electronics Clothing Jewellery Home and living Beauty and care Pharmacy Food Game top-up Made to order Your messages Mark all as read Back The same mistake (Ordered by mistake) has now happened three times in 90 days. Please take more care.
did: The shop asked to return a strip "Ordered by mistake". The owner approved it and named it the shop's mistake. Then the same for a return that was the staff's mistake. The shop's and the staff member's messages were read.
